Meme Royale is live! ⚔️

We built a Clash Royale-inspired multiplayer game featuring 50+ meme characters from across the crypto space.

And for the first time, an Imagine game is fully optimized for both PC and mobile.

Build your deck, deploy your favorite meme characters, defend your towers and battle other players in real time.

We're also introducing $ROYAL, the native token powering Meme Royale's in-game economy.

The game is free to play, but holding $50+ worth of $ROYAL makes you eligible for competition rewards. Players can use SOL/ROYAL to unlock new cards and gems, with a portion of game fees going toward $IMAGINE buybacks.

No downloads required. Just open your browser and play.

Built in just a few days using our upcoming Imagine Pro engine.

This is another step toward what we've been working on: turning internet culture and community IP into actual playable games, while making game creation faster and more accessible than ever.

50+ meme characters. Real-time battles. PC + Mobile.

And we're just getting started.

Play Meme Royale: https://memeroyale.imaginestudio.fun
